Basis for Intervening:
Pursuant to Rules 212 and 214 of the Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, 18 C.F.R. §§ 385.212, 214, American Electric Power Service Corporation (“AEPSC”), on behalf of its affiliate AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc., moves to intervene in this proceeding.

American Electric Power Company, Inc. is a multi-state electric utility holding company system providing electric service at retail and wholesale. AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc. is a Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”) transmission owner and member. 

On August 28, 2026, MISO filed tariff revisions to establish Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads. The revisions address matters identified by the Commission in Docket No. EL26-70-000, including large-load visibility, ramp rates, disturbance ride-through, and transmission provisions designed to minimize disruptions to existing commercial arrangements.

As a MISO transmission owner and member, AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc. has an interest in this proceeding that cannot adequately be represented by any other party. Therefore, AEP requests that the Commission grant this motion to intervene.
